title: Town map and directions sheet
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Local area, holiday and travel: town, region and country; holidays (2.3, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 32 (Town map and directions sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 32: Directions: the imperative and asking the way. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

head: Arabic
English
rows: excuse me, how do I get to the station?

model.title: From the station to the masjid (to a woman).

blocks.text: The roads run along the empty squares. Write directions from the station to the masjid three times: to a man, to a woman and to a group.

questions.q: Give a man directions: go straight on, then take the first street on the left.
questions.a: اِذْهَبْ مُسْتَقِيمًا، ثُمَّ خُذِ الشَّارِعَ الأَوَّلَ عَلَى اليَسَارِ.

questions.q: Ask: Where is the nearest masjid?
Translate: It is ten minutes' walk away.
Core: Using the town map (worksheet), write directions for three routes: one to a man, one to a woman, one to a group.
questions.a: Marked for correct imperative forms, place words and prepositions.

questions.q: Extend: Write a four-line dialogue: a visitor asks the way and how far; you answer.
questions.a: For example: عَفْوًا، كَيْفَ أَصِلُ إِلَى المَكْتَبَةِ؟ اِذْهَبْ مُسْتَقِيمًا ثُمَّ اِنْعَطِفْ يَمِينًا. هَلْ هِيَ بَعِيدَةٌ؟ لَا، عَلَى بُعْدِ خَمْسِ دَقَائِقَ.

questions.q: Stretch: Say 'do not turn left' (to a man) with لَا النَّاهِيَة.

questions.a: C) اِنْعَطِفُوا يَمِينًا. Group: ـُوا: اِنْعَطِفُوا.

questions.q: 'Take' to a woman: A) خُذِي B) خُذْ C) خُذُوا
Big question: ask the way and give one direction in Arabic.
questions.a: For example: كَيْفَ أَصِلُ إِلَى المَحَطَّةِ؟ اِذْهَبْ مُسْتَقِيمًا.
